tools.name: web-search
tools.description: Search the web via DuckDuckGo (no API key). Returns up to max_results entries of {title, url, content (≤1500 chars)}. May fail with a bot-detection error from heavily-used server IPs.

tools.name: verdict
tools.description: Publish a named verdict (k/v pairs) that downstream triggers can route on via `when <key> <op> <value>`. Last write per key wins.

tools.name: web-fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL (http/https only). By default the response is run through an HTML/XML tag stripper and capped at 25000 chars — keeps LLM context manageable for typical pages and feeds. Pass `raw: true` to get the unparsed body (still char-capped). Pass `max_chars` (1000-200000) to override the cap. Default timeout 15s.
